support.title: Explore core services and find the right support.

items.question: What types of therapy do you offer?
items.answer: We offer counselling for anxiety, grief, relationship concerns, low confidence and life transitions.

items.question: Are sessions confidential?
items.answer: Yes. We explain confidentiality clearly before your first appointment.

items.question: Do I need a referral?
items.answer: No referral is needed. You can book an initial conversation directly.

items.question: What if I am not sure I need therapy?
items.answer: The first call is a calm way to decide whether support feels right.
